shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/navigation && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/table','@gravity-ui/navigation']) { const x=require(p+'/package.json'); console.log(p,x.version) }\""

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/docs 2>/dev/null || true; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/docs 2>/dev/null || true; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/table node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation -maxdepth 2 -iname '*docs*' -o -name 'README.md' | sort | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null || cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; printf '\\n--- NAV INDEX ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null || cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '100,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '470,640p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '2500,2590p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/guides/migration-from-uikit-table/migration-from-uikit-table.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"useRowSelectionFixedHandler|getGroupedRowModel|getRowSelectionModel|onGroupingChange\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; sed -n '1330,1390p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/guides/migration-from-uikit-table/migration-from-uikit-table.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"autoReset|getGroupedRowModel\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm | head -60; rg -n \"const useTable|function useTable\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm -g '*.js' | head"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js; rg -n "export (declare )?(const|function|type|interface) (House|Gear|User|Shopping|Cart|Clipboard|ListCheck)" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts | head -50; rg -n "House|Gear|User|ShoppingCart|Cart|Clipboard|ListCheck" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts | head -50'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"const selectionColumn|selectionColumn =\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm -g '*.js' -g '*.d.ts'; rg -n \"HouseIcon|UserIcon|GearIcon|CartIcon|ListIcon\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; rg -n "House|User|Gear|Cart|List" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/constants/selectionColumn.js'

/bin/bash -lc 'command -v patch || command -v perl || command -v node || true'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export (type|interface|declare const) .*Label|DataLens|theme.*success|theme.*accent\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/components/Label/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/components/Label/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*Label*' -name '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg -n \"type Icon|interface Icon|declare const Icon\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/House.d.ts; rg -n \"enableColumnReordering|ColumnDef\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/*.js | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "ExpandedState|ColumnOrderState" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -50; rg -n "export type ExpandedState|declare type ExpandedState" node_modules/@tanstack/table-core/build/lib/types/*.d.ts | head'

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0777 -pi -e \"s/import type \\{DataLens\\} from '\\@gravity-ui\\/uikit';\\n//; s/statusLenses: Record<OrderStatus, DataLens>/statusLenses: Record<OrderStatus, 'info' | 'warning' | 'accent' | 'success' | 'danger'>/; s/import type \\{Icon as IconType\\} from '\\@gravity-ui\\/icons';\\n//; s/icon: IconType/icon: (props: React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>) => React.JSX.Element;/; s/const \\[expanded, setExpanded\\] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>(\\{\\});/const [expanded, setExpanded] = React.useState<ExpandedState>({});/; s/import type \\{ColumnDef, GroupingState, RowSelectionState\\}/import type {ColumnDef, ExpandedState, GroupingState, RowSelectionState}/\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' src/App.tsx | cat -n"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0777 -pi -e \"s/'accent' \\| 'success' \\| 'danger'>/'success' | 'danger' |/; s/  shipped: 'accent',/  shipped: 'normal',/; s/React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>\\(\\{\\}\\)/React.useState<ExpandedState>({})/; s/const selectionColumn: ColumnDef<Order> = \\{/const selectionColumn: ColumnDef<Order, unknown> = {/\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '18,22p' src/App.tsx | cat -A"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0777 -pi -e \"s/const statusLenses: Record<OrderStatus, 'info' \\| 'warning' \\| 'success' \\| 'danger' \\| = \\{/const statusLenses: Record<OrderStatus, 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'normal'> = {/\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type ColumnDef\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/tanstack/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/tanstack.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/tanstack 2>/dev/null | head"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | rg -n '\"exports\"|tanstack|types' -A4"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/tanstack.d.ts; rg -n "export type ColumnDef" node_modules/@tanstack/table-core/build/lib/types/*.d.ts | head'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '80,115p' node_modules/@tanstack/table-core/build/lib/types.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0777 -pi -e \"s/\\n  enableColumnReordering: false,//\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"enableSubRowSelection|toggleSelected|getIsSomeSelected\" node_modules/@tanstack/table-core/build/lib/features/RowSelection.js | head -80; rg -n \"enableSubRowSelection\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -30"

npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check
git status --short
nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,190p' | tail -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -delete && find dist -maxdepth 1 -type d -empty -delete && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "find dist -type f -maxdepth 2 -printf '%p\\n' && find dist -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null || true && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'rm dist/assets/index-DgWWENZM.css dist/assets/index-CZhigjDP.js
rmdir dist/assets dist 2>/dev/null || true
